title: Jupiter
text: Jupiter is the largest planet in the Solar System, a gas giant with a mass more than twice that of all the other planets combined. Its Great Red Spot is a persistent storm larger than Earth.

title: Mars
text: Mars is the fourth planet from the Sun and looks red because of iron oxide on its surface. Olympus Mons, a shield volcano roughly 22 km high, is the tallest known volcano in the Solar System.

title: Neutron stars
text: A neutron star is the collapsed core of a massive star that ended in a supernova. It packs more than the mass of the Sun into a sphere about 20 km across, so its density is comparable to that of an atomic nucleus.

title: Redshift and expansion
text: Redshift is the stretching of light wavelengths from receding sources. In 1929 Edwin Hubble found that distant galaxies recede faster the farther away they are, which is evidence that the universe is expanding.

title: Saturn
text: Saturn is a gas giant famous for its ring system made mostly of water ice particles. Its average density is lower than that of water, so it is less dense than any other planet in the Solar System.

title: pH scale
text: pH is a logarithmic scale for acidity defined as the negative base-10 logarithm of the hydrogen ion activity. Pure water at 25 C has a pH of 7, lower values are acidic and higher values are basic.

title: Catalysts
text: A catalyst speeds up a reaction by offering an alternative pathway with a lower activation energy. It is not consumed by the reaction and does not change the position of equilibrium.

title: Noble gases
text: The noble gases of group 18 have full valence electron shells, so they rarely form compounds. Helium, neon and argon are examples, while xenon can form compounds with fluorine and oxygen.

title: Le Chatelier's principle
text: Le Chatelier's principle says that when a system at equilibrium is disturbed by a change in concentration, pressure or temperature, the system shifts to partly counteract the change.

title: Hydrochloric acid
text: Hydrochloric acid is a strong acid that dissociates completely in water. A 0.1 M solution has a pH close to 1, which is far more acidic than vinegar.

title: 해시 테이블
text: 해시 테이블은 키를 해시 함수로 배열의 위치에 대응시켜 평균 O(1) 시간에 탐색, 삽입, 삭제를 수행하는 자료구조이다. 서로 다른 키가 같은 위치에 대응되는 충돌은 체이닝이나 개방 주소법으로 해결한다.

title: 이진 탐색
text: 이진 탐색은 정렬된 배열에서 중간 원소와 비교하며 탐색 범위를 절반씩 줄이는 알고리즘으로 시간 복잡도는 O(log n)이다. 배열이 정렬되어 있지 않으면 사용할 수 없다.

title: 스택과 큐
text: 스택은 나중에 들어온 원소가 먼저 나가는 LIFO 구조이고, 큐는 먼저 들어온 원소가 먼저 나가는 FIFO 구조이다.

title: Big-O notation
text: Big-O notation describes an upper bound on how the running time of an algorithm grows with the input size n. For example, a single loop over n items is O(n) and two nested loops over n items are O(n^2).

title: TCP
text: TCP provides reliable, ordered delivery of a byte stream using sequence numbers, acknowledgements and retransmission. It establishes a connection with a three-way handshake.
